newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Port conditions update - S.Africa - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - S.Africa - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

RICHARDS BAY, Sept 29 - Some bulk vessels are facing delays of up to 38 days due to congestion on the common user bulk berth. Most severely affected by this is the fertiliser industry, which imports large volumes of sulphur.
The Port Authority is trying to alleviate the problem by diverting vessels to other ports and had wanted to equalise rail and port charges for this operation.
